Name: PERSEI Space
Description:
At PERSEI Space, we specialise in the development of cutting-edge subsystems for space deorbiting and In-Orbit-Servicing. 

Our innovative solutions are rooted in the transformative potential of space tethers, revolutionizing the way we fly and safeguard the celestial environment.

What Are Space Tethers?
Space tethers are a remarkable leap in space technology. They involve the deployment of conductive tapes in space, which may seem deceptively simple, but their applications are truly game-changing. These tethers serve a dual purpose offering drag and propulsion capabilities, making them a versatile choice for a wide range of space missions.

Deorbiting - Ensuring Space Sustainability:
One of the primary applications of space tethers is to facilitate space deorbiting, a critical component of space sustainability. By deploying these tapes, we generate an electromagnetic and atmospheric drag force in low Earth orbit. This process accelerates the satellite's descent towards Earth, ultimately leading to reentry and safe disposal at the end of its mission. In this way, PERSEI Space is committed to mitigating the issue of space debris, a growing concern in the space industry, by offering efficient and sustainable deorbiting solutions.

Propulsion - Active Mode for Spacecraft:
In addition to deorbiting, space tethers offer a dynamic propellant-less propulsion method for spacecraft. Our technology allows us to actuate in an active mode, enabling us to propel spacecraft to their desired orbits with unparalleled efficiency. By leveraging the inherent electrical conductivity of the tether, we harness electromagnetic forces within Earth's magnetic field, creating a green and cost-effective means of orbital maneuvering.

At PERSEI Space, we are passionate about the endless possibilities space tethers present in the realm of space exploration and sustainability. Our dedication to innovation, safety, and environmental responsibility drives us to push the boundaries of technology.

Name: SATERA
Description:
SPACE-BASED COMPOSITE ADS-B AND MULTILATERATION SYSTEM VALIDATION THROUGH SCALABLE SIMULATIONS (SATERA) will propose and validate an integrity estimator for space-based ADS-B systems based on crosschecking positions reported in ADS-B messages with position estimations provided by space-based MLAT systems.

To reach this goal, SATERA will apply a stepped approach starting by the definition of  high-level operational descriptions, identifying all the involved stakeholders, and detailing the CNS equipage of the fleet and the available air traffic services. 
The research team will develop theoretical models to assess and benchmark the proposed system architecture leading to a full list of functional requirements and interfaces description.

SATERA will develop a system performance prediction tool to compute the theoretical performance of a MLAT system whose receiving stations are onboard of a  constellation of LEO small satellites. This tool will take into consideration all the error sources that can affect the MLAT system performance and will be used to select the most suitable constellation.
For validating the SATERA solution also end-to-end system evaluation  tool that will be developed. Several validation exercises addressing the provision of composite space- based ADS-B+MLAT surveillance in the EURSAM and NAT corridors for realistic traffic will be done.

Description:

Aquí, no solo capacitan a las próximas generaciones de ingenieros y científicos espaciales, sino que también ofrecen cursos y publicaciones para el público en general, haciendo accesible la comprensión de estos avances y fomentando la curiosidad científica en todos los niveles.

En resumen, Space MegaCorp no solo está impulsando la innovación en la propulsión espacial, sino que también está liderando una nueva era de accesibilidad y educación en el ámbito espacial.

Muchas gracias.

Name: EDHPC 2025
Description:
The European Data Handling &  Data Processing Conference – EDHPC 2025 – will be held from the 13th to the 17th of October 2025 in Elche, Spain. It is organised by the European Space Agency (ESA), with the support of the local tourist office.

The EDHPC will be an international forum covering diverse aspects of the most relevant topics for on-board computers, on-board data handling systems, on-board data processing and microelectronics for space applications including both platform and payload applications (RF and optical).

The main objectives are:
> To bring together and foster cooperation between different experts in the areas of space data handling, data processing, and microelectronics components.
> To discuss architectures / reference designs / microelectronics component developments / performance of current and future data handling – data processing hardware for space.
> To establish closer links between industry and international / national space agencies, to enable further developments in these fields

We highly encourage professionals from industry, academia, research centres, and space agencies to contribute to and attend this conference. Participants will have further opportunities for networking during the industrial exhibition, which will take place throughout the week.

We have selected Elche for this EDHPC edition. Elche is a municipality of the province of Alicante in the Valencian Community in Spain. The rich history of the town reaches back to the ancient Greek, Carthaginians and Romans, who realised one of the very early environmental engineering projects with the Palmeral of Elche. It is the largest palm grove in Europe, which survived the centuries, and is now an Unesco World Heritage Site.

La finalidad es introducir en el mercado nuevas herramientas que permitan optimizar y mejorar los procesos actuales de gestión de nuestros clientes. 

Un ejemplo son los proyectos de GEOINTELIGENCIA que permiten desarrollar Sistemas de Alerta Temprana (SAT) como herramienta de ayuda a los responsables de activos, de infraestructuras,... para anticiparse a situaciones en las que se puedan producir incidentes o situaciones anómalas durante el proceso de toma de decisiones.

INVAR, en el ámbito de la ingeniería civil, también desarrolla proyectos relacionados con la gestión de infraestructuras mediante la realización de proyectos basados en movilidad, tráfico y seguridad viaria.

En definitiva, la actividad de la empresa INVAR se centra, por un lado, en la prestación de servicios de apoyo técnico, consultoría y asesoramiento y, por otro, en el desarrollo de servicios y productos innovadores bajo el marco de la I+D+i. 

La experiencia laboral del equipo humano de INVAR, permite ofrecer la realización de los siguientes servicios:

- ASESORAMIENTO TÉCNICO Y CONSULTORÍA
- INTELIGENCIA/VISION ARTIFICIAL

- GESTIÓN DE INFRAESTRUCTURAS

Name: Astraspec S.L.
Description:
AstraSpec is a technology-based company incubated at the ESA Business Incubation Centre Castilla y León (ESA-BIC), specialized in the development of advanced gas sensors based on Raman spectroscopy and the provision of complementary services, including:

 Spectroscopic databases

Our mission is to deliver precise, robust, and sustainable solutions for real-time, multi-gas detection, addressing critical needs in:
 Aerospace and space exploration
 Hydrogen value chain
 Biogas and renewable gases
 Chemical and petrochemical industry
 Mining and occupational safety
 Food and beverage industry
 Universities and research centers

What makes us different
 Simultaneous detection of any type of molecular gas (including H2, CO2, CH4, NH3, VOCs, O2, N2, etc.)
 In-line, real-time monitoring, even in highly dynamic processes
 High sensitivity and resolution without consumables
 Reliable results under extreme operational conditions

At AstraSpec, we are committed to leading the next generation of multi-gas sensors, supporting energy transition, industrial sustainability, and space exploration.

Learn more at: www.astraspec.eu

Name: Eu-BEST
Description:
Welcome to the official LinkedIn page of Eu-BEST (European Bench for Engine and Stage Testing)! 
We are a collaborative initiative funded by the European Commission and comprised of seven European space industry leaders and NewSpace companies dedicated to revolutionizing space infrastructure testing.

With the rise in private small launchers in Europe, ground segment capital and operational costs are becoming increasingly high, as 99.99% of a launcher’s lifespan is spent on the ground. To address this, Eu-BEST is offering standardized ground segment services to launchers, significantly reducing these costs.

As part of the Eu-BEST project, we are developing and operating an interoperable, modular, and mobile test bench for rocket engines and stages. Our test bench serves multiple launchers, locations, and development phases, ensuring a uniform user experience. 

By leveraging the latest technologies and industry best practices, we aim to set new standards for space testing, contributing to the advancement of Europe’s space transportation and ground technologies. 

Join us on our journey as we pave the way for a more accessible and cost-effective approach to space testing. Explore our page to learn more about our innovative solution, latest developments, and industry insights. Together, let's unlock the potential of space testing with Eu-BEST!

This project is funded by the European Commission under its Horizon Europe program and is currently under development.

Name: WorldMapping Solutions
Description:
WorldMapping Solutions S.L. (WMS) es una empresa tecnológica especializada en servicios avanzados de hidrografía, cartografía marina, geofísica aplicada e innovación en teledetección. Con sede en Bilbao y oficina en el BIC Bizkaia, WMS combina sensores de última generación como multihaz (multibeam), sonar de barrido lateral (side scan sonar), perfilador de fondo (sub-bottom profiler), magnetometría (magnetometer), LiDAR, fotogrametría, ROVs y USVs, para ofrecer soluciones precisas y adaptadas a las necesidades de cada cliente.
Participamos en proyectos nacionales e internacionales en los sectores de la hidrografía, medio ambiente, obra civil, energías renovables offshore y arqueología subacuática, colaborando con grandes ingenierías, universidades y centros tecnológicos.
Además, WMS impulsa líneas propias de I+D+i, como el proyecto FOTOBATI, centrado en el desarrollo de técnicas de batimetría a partir de fotogrametría aérea corregida mediante algoritmos de deep learning.

STELLOR develops engineering tools and workflows to support system-level analysis, trade-off studies and decision-making during the earliest stages of space mission design.

Its first product, ASTROLAB, is a digital mission engineering platform designed to help engineers explore mission concepts, assess system-level implications and iterate efficiently when design flexibility is highest.

Name: 5G-GOVSATCOM
Description: The project aims to integrate 5G-NTN with EU-GOVSATCOM services by developing and evaluating key technologies in a user environment. It involves adapting radio access procedures for geostationary mobile terminals, integrating user equipment with operationally-focused antennas, and enabling seamless handover between terrestrial networks and NTN. Validations will occur in lab settings before experimental testing with final users, focusing on telemedicine in maritime areas and crisis management connectivity.

Name: Geo-Environmental Cartography and Remote Sensing Group (CGAT)
Description: Welcome to the webpage of the Geo-Environmental Cartography and Remote Sensing Group (Cartografia GeoAmbiental y Teledeteccion – CGAT). We are a multidisciplinary research group created in 2000, at the Department of Cartographic Engineering, Geodesy and Photogrammetry of the Polytechnic University of Valencia (Spain). Our main interests are focused on the development of geoinformation technology tools based on remote sensing, GIS and LiDAR processing to analyse and map the territory, and their application in the study of the environment and natural resources in its broadest sense: forestry, agriculture, urban and coastal areas. In addition to the development of several research lines and projects, and the collaboration with administration and industry in technology transfer and outreach, a substantial part of our activities is focused on education and teaching at undergraduate and graduate levels.

Name: DISPEC Project
Description:
The DISPEC project offers new high-level data products based on advanced data processing techniques that improve data quality, provides estimates of ionospheric characteristics based on the joint processing of space and ground data, provides results from post-processing of data for improved ionospheric specification, and exploits long-term time series for the study of long-term trends in the ionosphere in connection to atmospheric long-term dynamics and geophysical phenomena. Specifically, DISPEC derived high-level data products aim at:
- Providing fast processing of time series that lead to curated data.
- Deriving new high-level data products based on the exploitation of raw data from multi-locations and multi-instruments, useful for input to ionospheric specification models.
- Deriving new ionospheric indicators based on the post-processing of raw satellite and ground-based instruments’ data useful for a quick mapping of ongoing ionospheric irregularities.
- Providing proxies for geophysical phenomena and long-term trends in the ionosphere.

The main objective of DISPEC project is the exploitation of bottomside and topside ionospheric data, provided by space missions – such as Swarm, DORIS, GRACE, GRACE-FO, Spire, COSMIC-2 – and by ground-based GNSS receivers and ionosonde sounders, to support research activities for improved ionospheric specification, through the derivation of high-level data products. The project outcomes have the potential to complement the ESA Space Science Archives and the Space Weather Network, the data collections provided by the global networks of ionosondes and GNSS ground based receivers, and to enhance the capacity of European Research Infrastructures.

Name: KeplerKoord S.L.
Description: Overview KeplerKoord develops next-generation positioning and navigation technology designed for environments where GPS is unreliable, denied, or unavailable. Built on RPCS (Real Coordinate Projection System), our solution delivers real coordinates, real distances, and real targets, ensuring precision, integrity, and resilience across critical operations. By integrating multi-source verification,including inertial systems, radar, and geospatial intelligence - KeplerKoord enables accurate and interoperable navigation across mining, aerospace, autonomous systems, and critical infrastructure. From underground and polar regions to contested or disrupted GNSS environments, KeplerKoord brings space-grade navigation reliability to real-world operations.

We believe sustainable rocketry is not just possible — it's essential. ROCK-e combines performance, safety, and environmental responsibility to meet the demands of a new space era.

 Join us in launching the future — without leaving a trace.

Name: The Geographical Club | Malaqa Analytica
Description:
The Geographical Club es el espacio editorial y estratégico impulsado por qsimov S.L..
Un laboratorio de pensamiento aplicado donde la geografía deja de ser decorado y vuelve a ser estructura.

No trabajamos con datos para generar dashboards.
Trabajamos con datos para comprender el territorio y tomar decisiones con criterio. No entendemos el dato satelital como un fin en sí mismo, sino como el combustible necesario para una interpretación estratégica y ética del entorno.

Nuestras líneas de actuación:
• Consultoría en Teledetección: Procesamiento y análisis de datos multiespectrales y radar (Python, PlanetScope, AIRBUS Pléiades Neo, Sentinel, Landsat) para la gestión ambiental y la agricultura de precisión.
• Sostenibilidad y Territorio: Aplicación de criterios biotecnológicos y geográficos para la toma de decisiones en entornos urbanos, rurales o más complejos y globales como el Mediterráneo Occidental.
• Estrategia y toma de decisiones: Defensa del rigor científico frente a la narrativa de la innovación vacía.

Como brazo editorial y laboratorio de ideas de qsimov S.L., este canal se organiza bajo tres ejes fundamentales:
1. #GeographicalClub: Reflexiones sobre pensamiento geográfico y soberanía territorial.
2. #ElSumidero: Crítica técnica y ética sobre la innovación superficial, el estado de la tecnología en la empresa y la sostenibilidad de escaparate. 
3. #Insights: Divulgación científica vinculada a nuestra investigación en teledetección, biotecnología agrícola avanzada y servicios profesionales. 

En un entorno saturado de opinión rápida y soluciones empaquetadas, defendemos:
• Rigor antes que tendencia
• Diagnóstico antes que herramienta
• Valor antes que visibilidad

Name: VOMA Analytics
Description:
VOMA (Vessel Observation & Maritime Analysis) is a next-generation maritime intelligence platform dedicated to providing 24/7 global transparency over our oceans. By bridging the gap between high-resolution satellite imagery and advanced Artificial Intelligence, we provide a constant "eye in the sky" capable of monitoring even the most isolated maritime regions. Our platform transforms complex space-based data into actionable insights, helping organizations track vessel activity with high reliability regardless of weather or light conditions.

Our mission is to illuminate the dark oceans and ensure a more secure, transparent, and sustainable future for our seas. We strive to protect critical marine ecosystems and enhance global maritime security by providing the AI-powered surveillance tools needed to ensure no activity goes unnoticed.
